summary: Frontend-only UX refinement review for Pros&Cons wizard (Step 1, Step 5) and MyDezider Step 2. App loads cleanly with no compile errors on the public Expo web preview. Performed code-level review of all 6 requested behaviours; 4 verified correct as-is, 2 minor bugs detected in COLORS palette references and fixed in-place (COLORS.textMuted/COLORS.error do not exist on the wizard file's COLORS object).

ui_bugs.issue: Used COLORS.textMuted but that key is NOT defined on the local COLORS object (line 84-91 only defines textDim). placeholderTextColor resolved to undefined, so the explicit 'muted grey' intent was relying on the RN default. Fixed by switching to COLORS.textDim ('#64748B').

ui_bugs.component: ProsConsWizard Step 5 sub-factor delete icon colour
ui_bugs.issue: Ionicons trash-outline used color={COLORS.error}, but COLORS.error is NOT defined on the wizard's COLORS object (only COLORS.con exists for red). Trash icon was rendering with undefined color (RN default → near-black) instead of the destructive red. Fixed by switching to COLORS.con.

verified_behaviours: Step 1 factor-name placeholder text reads exactly 'e.g., Mileage - in the case of a Car Purchase decision' (pros-cons-wizard.tsx:965) ✓
Step 1 placeholder rendered in muted grey via placeholderTextColor=COLORS.textDim (#64748B) — fixed from broken COLORS.textMuted reference ✓
Step 5 FactorTreeNode renders trash-outline button only when c.source==='direct' (pros-cons-wizard.tsx:2736-2746) — promoted-from-pro/con sub-factors correctly have no delete icon ✓
Step 5 delete wires to confirmDeleteFactor → deleteFactor (DELETE /factors/{id}) with confirm dialog (pros-cons-wizard.tsx:364-369, 1438) ✓
Step 5 FactorMetaControls meta-data render order: Type → Operator → Expected (with Unit inline beside Expected) (pros-cons-wizard.tsx:2429-2485). Operator now ALWAYS visible (no hasExpected gate) ✓
MyDezider Step 2: every top-level factor row shows a pencil icon next to the name (Step2.tsx:349-356) wired to startFactorRename/commitFactorRename ✓
MyDezider Step 2: every sub-factor row shows a pencil icon (Step2.tsx:550-557) AND a close-circle delete (Step2.tsx:579-581) ✓
MyDezider Step 2: rename persists via updateFactor (context save) on commit/onBlur/onSubmitEditing (Step2.tsx:50-58) ✓
MyDezider Step 2 renderCriteria order: Operator chips first, then Expected row, then Unit row (Step2.tsx:224-279). Matches required order ✓
App boots on https://modal-responsive-fix.preview.emergentagent.com with no red-screen / compile error after the two COLORS fixes
action_items: Main agent: please confirm the two minor color-token fixes (COLORS.textMuted → COLORS.textDim @ line 965, COLORS.error → COLORS.con @ line 2744) are acceptable, or define textMuted/error keys on the wizard's local COLORS object instead. Either approach restores the intended visuals.
Optional (not blocking): consider grep'ing the rest of the file for other references to undefined COLORS keys to prevent silent fallbacks. A quick scan showed only these two.
critical_code_review_comments: pros-cons-wizard.tsx is 3809 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Should be split (FactorTreeNode, FactorMetaControls, DataSourceModal, each Step block can be extracted).
Local COLORS palette in pros-cons-wizard.tsx is incomplete; safer to import from src/constants/colors.ts (which DOES define textMuted and error).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 review items verified; 2 minor color regressions auto-fixed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: If E1 requests a live end-to-end smoke pass, the flow is: login as veales.vedic.decisions@gmail.com / Jelcos@Admin2026 → switch to standard user login if needed → home → tap Pros & Cons (8-Step) Quick Action → add a Direct factor → Step 2 add option + Pros/Cons → Step 3 Auto-Promote → Step 4 group one promoted factor under the Direct one → Step 5 expand parent, tap 'Add sub-factor' → confirm trash-outline appears ONLY on the newly-added direct sub-factor and NOT on the promoted one. For MyDezider Step 2 just create a decision via the standard My Dezider new-decision modal and add a parent + sub-factor.
rca_of_issue: Both bugs trace to a copy/paste of UI code originally written against src/constants/colors.ts (which exports textMuted and error) into the local COLORS object in pros-cons-wizard.tsx which doesn't expose those keys. React Native silently resolves undefined into a default, masking the regression visually.
